image_description: A close-up, vertical shot of a grey whale's head and rostrum emerging vertically from deep blue water. The whale's snout is pointed upwards, displaying the characteristic arched rostrum and two blowholes at the apex. The skin is dark grey/black with significant white mottling and barnacle clusters, particularly on the left side of the rostrum. Water splashes around the base of the emergence. The body, flippers, and tail are submerged and not visible.
